excursion: Start at deepest DD. First CC succeeds, first strictly positive return to the origin fails. A self-loop on the first step is a strict return.
grid: A[x][y] with x the long player's progress from deepest D, y the short player's. For depth d, positions 0,...,d-1 are D, d,...,2d-1 are C. At d-1 and d the action is weakest. The time-zero origin and the first CC site are included. A CC site carries its first-entry probability. Unreachable sites have value zero.
conditioning: All path statistics except success_before_strict_return are conditional on first CC before a strict origin return. An expected-visits cell counts every visit. An ever-hit cell counts a path at most once.
first_action_change: short_first means DC is first, long_first means CD is first, simultaneous means first CC precedes every mixed state. The two position arrays sum to their respective first-change probabilities.
declined_switches: Expected count of private coins rejecting a weak loss in B, including the last step. With depth >=2, a hold at a weak site identifies this event.

precision.method: Outward-rounded positive elimination, forward and backward Green solves, and sparse selected inverse from exact rational transitions. Every displayed number has equally rounded interval endpoints.
precision.validation: Dense rational Gauss-Jordan inverse checks at (3,2) B with kP=99/100, (2,2) L with kP=2/3, and (1,1) L with kP=0.
